summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 與雲端基礎設施需求強勁，NetApp 繳出亮眼財報並上調財測，帶動市場看多情緒。

bullish.title: NetApp Q1 Beat and Raised Guidance Put AI Storage Growth in Focus

bullish.title: NTAP Stock Up 14.8% in 3 Months Can AI Momentum Keep It Climbing?
